title: Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Storage Capacity and Overage Schedule
content:
Storage capacity in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) is a limit in cubic feet, measured against the peak daily cubic feet the seller's inventory occupies in a calendar storage month. The figures below are set per program.

| Program | Storage capacity limit (cubic feet) | Capacity overage fee per cubic foot above the limit (USD) | Consecutive storage months with an overage fee after which inbound shipments are suspended | Calendar days the payments balance may stay negative before inbound shipments are suspended |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 500 | 10.00 | 2 | 30 |
| FBN Core Program | 2500 | 10.00 | 2 | 30 |
| FBN Growth Program | 10000 | 10.00 | 2 | 30 |
| FBN Scale Program | 40000 | 8.00 | 3 | 30 |
| FBN Premier Program | 150000 | 6.00 | 3 | 45 |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 600000 | 5.00 | 3 | 60 |

**How usage is measured.** In every program, usage is measured as the peak daily cubic feet in the storage month: the highest single-day volume of the seller's inventory during that calendar month is compared with the limit.

## Points of reading

- The capacity limit and the overage fee rate are read from the same program row.
- The suspension figures are counts: a number of consecutive storage months, and a number of calendar days.
- Worked reading (hypothetical usage): an enrollment in FBN Core Program whose peak daily volume in a storage month is 2740 cubic feet stands 240 cubic feet above its 2500 cubic foot limit; at 10.00 USD per cubic foot that month's overage amount is 2400.00 USD. The same peak of 2500 cubic feet exactly is not above the limit.
